snippet.title: Benny's Backrooms - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Benny's Backrooms EARLY ACCESS Gameplay Trailer
PLAY ON STEAM: https://rb.gy/jomm3k

A labyrinth of infinitely-generated levels awaits your arrival! Explore the Backrooms, discover new entities, and extract the resources you need to survive your day job as an employee of Alcazar. You can choose to explore alone or with friends in online co-op!

Discord https://rb.gy/meisfx
Website https://rb.gy/l5pojz
X https://rb.gy/x5jvcj
Insta https://rb.gy/2hd0j
